_comment: Suite registry for scripts/test.py (docs/TESTING.md). Plain JSON, no comments inside entries.
Placeholders in command/env/result: {root} repo root, {dir} suite dir, {name} script file name, {stem} script name
without extension, {parent} name of the suite dir, {API_URL} {WEB_URL} {FRONTEND_DIR} {report_dir} {result} {only}.
prereqs: hard prerequisites (suite is SKIPPED when one is missing). soft_prereqs: only part of the suite needs them
(e.g. its Playwright checks); missing ones are reported as warnings. registers: sign-ups (POST /api/auth/register)
the suite makes per run (limit: 10 per hour per client IP). Discovery rules add suites for new files automatically.

unit.title: Unit
unit.proves: Pure logic is correct in isolation: no database, no network, no docker (sockets and SQLAlchemy connections are blocked).

functional.title: Functional
functional.proves: The API behaves correctly in-process (FastAPI TestClient) against a real, throwaway MySQL schema built by the migrations.

system.title: System
system.proves: The running stack (api + worker + mysql + web) meets the BRD requirements through its public API, SQL checks and some UI checks.

e2e.title: End-to-end
e2e.proves: Whole journeys work through the real worker, SES stand-in (moto), SES webhooks and a fake IMAP mailbox.

ui.title: UI (Playwright)
ui.proves: Screens render and behave correctly in a real browser against the running stack, with DB cross-checks.

suites.data: none (pure functions; network and database are blocked)
suites.notes: tests/unit has its own pytest.ini, so tests/conftest.py (database) is never loaded for this layer.

suites.data: a throwaway MySQL schema (TEST_DB_NAME, default vtest), recreated before each run unless --keep-db; every test module registers its own tenants
suites.notes: Same command as CI. Runs on the host when the app's Python dependencies are installed, otherwise in a throwaway container from TEST_PY_IMAGE on the compose network.

suites.data: none (reads the frontend source and the API's OpenAPI document)
suites.notes: Every API call in Vector_Frontend/src must match a backend route and method. Exit code 1 lists the unmatched calls.

suites.data: own workspaces W and W2 via self sign-up
suites.notes: Oct-12 development round: multi-company contacts, @mentions, KPI reports, purge, repeated DELETE, input bounds.

suites.data: own workspaces A, B (isolation) and P (performance) via self sign-up
suites.notes: BRD 5.2 contact management, CM NFRs (10k import, search speed), section 7 data rules. Runs the global CRM purge job (BRD defines it as global).

suites.extra_args_hint: --no-ui, --no-worker (skip the cases that wait for the scheduler)
suites.data: own workspaces A and B via self sign-up; role users inserted by SQL inside A
suites.notes: BRD 4, 5.4 hierarchy, 5.5 daily new-contact limit (waits for the worker's scheduler), 5.6 leads and SQL, 5.7 pipeline.

suites.data: workspaces A and B created once and cached in system_tests/outreach/.state.json (sign-up rate limit); every run uses fresh, uniquely named data inside them
suites.notes: BRD 5.1 defect fixes (BR-DF), 5.3 outreach, 7 compliance. Runs a fake IMAP server reached from the containers at 172.18.0.1.

suites.data: tenants A and B cached in system_tests/api_sweep/.state.json for 25 minutes, then rebuilt
suites.notes: Every endpoint in ENDPOINTS.json: auth, roles, hierarchy, validation, duplicates, isolation (about 5,800 cases).

suites.data: own workspaces via self sign-up; every expected number is computed from the data the script seeds
suites.notes: BRD 5.8-5.12, 6 platform NFRs, 8 KPIs. ALWAYS LAST: its login rate-limit checks lock this client IP out of logins for about 15 minutes.

suites.data: each journey signs up its own workspaces; the SES stand-in is shared, so mail is always filtered by the journey's own recipients
suites.notes: J1-J6. Needs the e2e wiring (vector-api:e2e image, ses-mock, SEND_ON_ANY_DAY=true): python3 scripts/test.py env up --e2e. Exits 2 with instructions when the stand-ins are not ready.

only.syntax: regular expression over case ids (ONLY env); results merge into the previous results.json

suites.extra_args_hint: sub-suite names, e.g. auth shell wizard
suites.data: workspaces cached in system_tests/ui_outreach/.state.json (sign-ups and logins are rate limited); logins use a per-workspace X-Forwarded-For
suites.notes: Outreach/admin screens: auth, shell, security, campaigns, wizard, details, library, prospects, mailboxes, inbox/domain, admin.

suites.data: tenants created by SQL (not sign-up), cached in system_tests/ui_crm/state/ and wiped of CRM data at the start of each run
suites.notes: CRM and sales screens. Logins are paced to 25 per 5 minutes.

discovery.data: expected: own workspace via common.Workspace (check the script)
discovery.notes: Discovered automatically (a system_tests/<dir>/run_<x>.py not listed in suites).

discovery.data: a reusable tenant from ui_crm's Tenant.get('<area>') (created by SQL, its rows wiped at the start of each run)
discovery.notes: Discovered automatically. Convention: `if (isMain(import.meta)) standalone('<stem>', run)` from ../ui_crm/crm_common.mjs, so results land in system_tests/ui_crm/out/<stem>/results.json (the first fresh file of the listed paths is used).
